title: Before the Fire
fa: مرده بدم زنده شدم، گریه بدم خنده شدم
دولت عشق آمد و من دولت پاینده شدم
en: I was dead, I came alive.
I was weeping, I became laughter.
and I became fortune that lasts.

segments.en: I was dead... I came alive.
I was weeping... I became laughter.

segments.fa: دولت عشق آمد و من دولت پاینده شدم
segments.en: Love's fortune came, and I became fortune that lasts.
